extraSql.purpose: Get daily kWh and heating degree days for Brixton (S2) across both windows to visually assess weather impact
extraSql.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(m.ts AS DATE) AS d,
    SUM(m.kwh) AS daily_kwh,
    AVG(t.temp_c) AS avg_temp_c
  FROM kilowhy.meter_hh m
  LEFT JOIN kilowhy.temp_hourly t ON CAST(m.ts AS DATE) = CAST(t.ts AS DATE) AND HOUR(m.ts) = HOUR(t.ts)
  WHERE m.site_id = 'S2'
    AND m.ts >= (SELECT date_sub(CAST(MAX(ts) AS DATE), 56) FROM kilowhy.meter_hh WHERE site_id = 'S2')
  GROUP BY CAST(m.ts AS DATE)
)
SELECT d, daily_kwh, avg_temp_c,
       GREATEST(15.5 - avg_temp_c, 0) AS hdd
FROM daily
ORDER BY d
LIMIT 5000

evidence.title: Meter quality checks (S2)
evidence.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT site_id, ts, kwh FROM kilowhy.meter_hh WHERE site_id IN ('S2') AND ts >= timestamp '2026-08-27 00:00:00' AND ts < timestamp '2026-10-22 00:00:00'),
lagged AS (SELECT site_id, ts, kwh, LAG(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY ts) AS prev_kwh FROM base),
grp AS (SELECT site_id, ts, kwh, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_kwh IS NULL OR kwh <> prev_kwh THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY ts) AS g FROM lagged),
runs AS (SELECT site_id, kwh, g, MIN(ts) AS start_ts, MAX(ts) AS end_ts, COUNT(*) AS n FROM grp GROUP BY site_id, kwh, g)
SELECT CASE WHEN kwh = 0 THEN 'zero_run' ELSE 'flatline' END AS check_name, site_id, CAST(start_ts AS STRING) AS start_ts, CAST(end_ts AS STRING) AS end_ts, n, kwh AS value FROM runs WHERE (kwh = 0 AND n >= 4) OR (kwh <> 0 AND n >= 12)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duplicate_ts', site_id, CAST(ts AS STRING), CAST(ts AS STRING), COUNT(*), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) FROM base GROUP BY site_id, ts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'slots_per_day', site_id, CAST(CAST(ts AS DATE) AS STRING), CAST(CAST(ts AS DATE) AS STRING), COUNT(*), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) FROM base GROUP BY site_id, CAST(ts AS DATE) HAVING COUNT(*) <> 48
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rows', site_id, CAST(MIN(ts) AS STRING), CAST(MAX(ts) AS STRING), COUNT(*), SUM(kwh) FROM base GROUP BY site_id
ORDER BY check_name, site_id, start_ts

answer.headline: Electricity use rose 179 kWh (6.9%) driven mainly by colder weather

sentences.text: Electricity use rose by 179 kWh (6.9%) from 2,594 kWh to 2,773 kWh, driven mainly by colder weather that raised heating degree days from 0.6 HDD to 45.0 HDD, with the weather-driven part of the volume effect accounting for £37.31 (35.6% of the bill change).
The price-level effect added £57.84 (55.3% of the bill change), making it the largest single component of the bill increase.
The generation mix shifted toward more expensive power, with wind share falling from 30.1% to 27.0% and gas share rising from 23.9% to 28.2%.
A single day on 2026-10-17 contributed £32.40 (31.0%) of the total bill change.

ruledOut.text: Timing shift was ruled out; the change in peak-band share was only 0.1 pp and the largest daily-schedule move was −8.3 pp, below any material threshold.
Meter fault was ruled out; zero meter faults were found across the one site checked.
Tariff change was ruled out; the standing charge stayed at 37.65 p/day in both windows.
Data gap was ruled out; zero site-windows had missing or extra half-hours across the two windows checked.
Unusual usage day was ruled out; the largest deviation from expected usage was only 2.6 standard deviations, below the flagged level of 4 sd.

recommendation.text: Load shifting out of the 16:00-19:00 peak band saved only £0.10 on window B prices by moving 0.4 kWh. The Agile tariff cost £779.34 in window B, £170.08 less than the flat tariff comparison of £949.42 for the same kWh; that flat-tariff figure is a historical counterfactual, not advice to switch.
